title: crepis hololeion
intro: Crepis hololeion, commonly known as Hawksbeard or Sowbane, is a species of flowering plant in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including digestive issues and skin problems, due to its potential health benefits. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help alleviate symptoms of conditions such as arthritis and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Crepis hololeion include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
